scope: Authorized production read-only metadata SELECT. Only pgrst.db_schemas was returned; no other settings, secrets, or table rows read.
query:
SELECT
  current_setting('pgrst.db_schemas', true) AS session_pgrst_db_schemas,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'database', CASE WHEN s.setdatabase = 0 THEN '*' ELSE d.datname END,
      'role', r.rolname,
      'setting', cfg.setting
    ) ORDER BY s.setdatabase, cfg.setting)
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_db_role_setting s
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles r ON r.oid = s.setrole
    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_database d ON d.oid = s.setdatabase
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(s.setconfig) AS cfg(setting)
    WHERE r.rolname = 'authenticator'
      AND cfg.setting LIKE 'pgrst.db_schemas=%'
  ), '[]'::jsonb) AS authenticator_database_db_schemas,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(cfg.setting ORDER BY cfg.setting)
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(r.rolconfig) AS cfg(setting)
    WHERE r.rolname = 'authenticator'
      AND cfg.setting LIKE 'pgrst.db_schemas=%'
  ), '[]'::jsonb) AS authenticator_role_db_schemas;

limitation: This is not a complete proof of live PostgREST API server config from other configuration sources. Check explicit runtime exposed-schema configuration before treating private as definitively unexposed.
